data.name: DeviceUnavailableMessage
data.value: The device is no longer advertising. Refresh and try again.

data.name: PairingFingerprintMissingMessage
data.value: This discovery record does not include a certificate fingerprint. Use QR pairing instead.

data.name: OneTimePairingCodePrompt
data.value: Enter the 8-digit code shown on the receiving device. The code expires quickly and is still combined with TLS certificate verification and receiver approval.

data.name: RequestPairingDetailsFormat
PairingTimedOutMessage
data.value: The pairing request expired before it was approved.

data.name: InvalidPortMessage
data.value: Enter a numeric port from 1 to 65535.

data.name: FreshCodeMessage
data.value: Enter the fresh 8-digit code shown on the receiving device.

data.name: ManualPairingBootstrapMessage
data.value: Manual IP pairing initially connects before the receiver certificate fingerprint is known. The 8-digit code and receiver approval authorize the bootstrap. SwiftDrop then binds the returned invitation to the exact TLS certificate it observed and will ask you to visually confirm that fingerprint before sending. Continue only on a network and device you expect.

data.name: ManualPairingTimedOutMessage
data.value: Manual pairing expired before it completed.

data.name: FolderPickerUnavailableMessage
data.value: SwiftDrop keeps received files in its app-private Received folder on this platform instead of asking for broad storage access.

data.name: NotificationPermissionNotGrantedMessage
data.value: SwiftDrop will continue transferring normally without optional completion/failure notifications. Required foreground transfer status is controlled by Android platform rules.

data.name: SavedSettingsMessage
data.value: Settings and device name were saved on this device.

data.name: SavedLanguageChangedMessage
data.value: Settings and device name were saved. Newly opened screens use the selected language; restart SwiftDrop to refresh screens that were already open.

data.name: ResetDeviceIdentityQuestionMessage
data.value: This creates a new device ID and certificate, invalidates current pairing invitations, and removes every locally trusted device. Other devices will no longer recognize this identity. Received files and transfer history are not deleted.

data.name: IdentityResetMessage
data.value: A new local identity and certificate were created.

data.name: ResetSettingsQuestionMessage
data.value: Restore SwiftDrop settings to their defaults? Device identity and trusted devices are not changed.

data.name: RevokeTrustedDeviceMessage
data.value: Future transfers from this device will require explicit confirmation again.

data.name: ClearTrustedDevicesMessage
data.value: This removes all locally stored trust decisions.

data.name: ClearDiagnosticLogMessage
data.value: This removes locally stored diagnostic events. Transfer history and received files are not changed.

data.name: DeveloperOptionsDisabledMessage
data.value: Enable safe developer diagnostics in Settings first.

data.name: UnableToOpenLinkFormat
data.value: SwiftDrop could not open the {0} on this device.

data.name: OpeningLinkUnsupportedFormat
data.value: Opening the {0} is not supported on this device.
